strings.ig_session_help: Login with your Instagram sessionid (works when password login is blocked). Get it: open instagram.com in your browser while logged in, press F12 > Application (Chrome) or Storage (Firefox) > Cookies > instagram.com > copy the value of 'sessionid'. Then send ME A PRIVATE MESSAGE: ig session <sessionid>. The bot never sees your password, but anyone with the sessionid can act as you, and the bot keeps it encrypted on the server with a key stored beside it. Log out of it any time with: ig out
